about: Decisions for the rows of the bathroom list (Annex IX) that the name match leaves to a person. Key: list id / NR of the PDF table. 'id' is the school chosen; 'site': 'none' leaves the row off the map, with the candidates to ask the IDB about. Each note says what the choice rests on: the village of the PDF row against the address of the ministry list (March 2024).
